abstract: Mechanized the cite-your-ticket code standard as scripts/tests/CodeCitationPolicy.Tests.ps1, ported from DocPolicy.Tests.ps1's shape per issue #42. The gate walks files added strictly after boundary commit d4db6f5baf2bd31bf41f9dc5804684334797cb35, checks code extensions derived from the real post-boundary corpus (.ps1 .psm1 .go .js .mjs .sh), excludes artifacts/** (machine-generated), .json (config/fixture, no comment syntax), and .md (docs have their own DocPolicy gate), and fails listing every violator by name if a post-boundary code file lacks a bare #N citation. Red-first with a stubbed always-cited function observed failing for the stated reason, then reverted to green; a scratch-repo Describe block proves the forward-only boundary independently of real repo history, and board/board.go (pre-boundary, uncited) is asserted absent from the real added-files set. Calibrated clean: all 21 real post-boundary code files already carried citations, so the gate landed green with zero fixes. No CI wiring change needed - .github/workflows/ci.yml already runs Invoke-Pester -Path ./scripts/tests. CLAUDE.md's CODE STANDARD section amended in the same commit to record the mechanism as landed (was previously marked attention-tier/deferred). scripts/tests suite: 182 -> 189 (189/189 passing) at commit 79cb5c909e2dafc898266b0c04258dc00673fb81 on branch car/process-42.
